overview: The Civic Compliance Hall is where citizens are processed, corrected, and instructed in Seru’s doctrine. It is the bureaucratic engine of purity enforcement.
history: Established to centralize doctrinal correction and administrative enforcement.
Purity auditoriums were added to screen citizens for ideological deviation.
Arcane compliance chambers were introduced to stabilize decree magic.
Praetorian oversight stations were integrated to ensure absolute obedience.
hooks: A compliance chamber reports a corrupted decree signature.
A citizen collapses during purity screening.
A Praetorian officer requests assistance with a mass‑compliance edict.
A decree kiosk malfunctions, issuing contradictory mandates.
